items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Red came in there. And Bill got off a night or two and he played for Bill. But Red never played any length of time. Maybe he might have made as much as a week with us or something like that.

ctx.x: So Red Bowman was just subbing for your...

He just subbed for... No, he... We added a... They had a couple of little acts came in there and when we got ahead and get a second trumpet to fill out the section, Red came in there. And Bill got off a night or two and he played for Bill. But Red never played any length of time. Maybe he might have made as much as a week with us or something like that. But that was the end. He's on one of the recording dates. No, no, he wasn't on that. I don't think. Yeah, he's in the discography, yeah. Yeah, well, which one was…
It would have been probably in 27. The one where they sing Throwing the Horns. Do you remember that song?
